name.en: Paleodictyon raised hexagonal mesh teaching relief
name.zh: Paleodictyon 六角网格凸起教学浮雕

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: thin connected tubes form a regular hexagonal mesh below sediment. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: raised-fossil-relief; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：纤细相连管道在沉积层下组成规则六角网。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凸起化石浮雕；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Paleodictyon on the Deep-Sea Floor
sources.supports: Hexagonal tunnel network and shafts; identity of maker unresolved
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original raised-fossil-relief teaching slab: a low connected thin tube network forms19 closed hexagonal cells on an exposed substrate. Basic hexagonal tunnel architecture and unresolved producer supported by the accessed primary study Introduction; modern surface openings are not copied into this fossil-relief display. Original nominal0.24m module, tube thickness, grid extent and gray palette are art choices. No exact ichnospecies, excavated specimen replica, coral/honeycomb organism, proven farming/ventilation mechanism or producer assignment; original Paleogene inventory context is not a universal range or coexistence claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创凸起化石浮雕教学岩板：低矮相连细管网在露面基底上形成19个闭合六角单元。已读原始研究引言支持六角管网基本结构及制造者未确定；不将现代海底表面小孔照搬作本项化石浮雕。原创0.24米名义模块、管厚、网格范围及灰色为美术设定。不指定潜迹种，不复制出土标本，不作珊瑚或蜂巢生物，不主张已证实的耕作、通风机制或制造者；原始古近纪分类背景不代表完整时代范围或共存。

claim_scope: Interpretive trace morphology: original negative crawling impression or positive fossil-relief display, not excavated specimen replication or a known producer.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
